obj.cause: The default list is created once at function definition and reused across calls, so append_item(1) leaves [1] in that shared list and append_item(2) then returns [1, 2] instead of [2].
obj.change: Do not use a mutable list as the default. Use a sentinel such as None and create a new list inside the function when no list is passed.
obj.verification: Call append_item(1) then assert append_item(2) == [2]; also confirm a passed-in list is still extended in place.
